Hi Carlos — thanks for the heads up. Looping in Laura and Rafael from finance to make sure we give bank-ready instructions.

Two options we can support depending on what your bank prefers:

A) Sender cover (recommended when possible):
- Instruct your bank to send the full invoice USD equivalent to our USD nostro (details below).
- Globex pays all intermediary and correspondent charges (OUR).
- Redwood will not deduct any correspondent fees from the settled amount; invoice amount remains unchanged.

B) Beneficiary net (common AP workflow):
- Your bank sends net to our beneficiary account; intermediary charges will be deducted en route and reduce the amount we receive.
- If you choose this, please confirm that your bank provides a full break-down of fees and the exact BRL debit amount so we can reconcile.

For BRL specifically:
- We can accept BRL into our Brazil local collection account. If you want to route BRL locally, please specify your bank’s intermediary chain; otherwise send in USD to our U.S. USD account and we will handle local payout.

I attached a short routing stub with our preferred chains for both USD and BRL. Laura/Rafael — can you confirm whether Redwood can absorb up to $50 USD of correspondent fees for this one-off onboarding as a courtesy? If not, please advise the strict instruction text for our customer.

Next steps for Globex: confirm which option (A or B), final BRL debit amount if sending net, and whether you need a VAT invoice scan before payment.

Carlos — hi, Laura here from Finance. Quick clarifications and the exact wire instruction language you can paste to your bank.

1) Preferred handling: sender-cover (OUR) is preferred for cross-border BRL so the invoiced USD amount is fully preserved. If your bank cannot support OUR for BRL, we will accept beneficiary-net but please provide the exact BRL amount your bank will debit and the intermediary fees list before you send.

2) Intermediary fee policy: Redwood typically asks customers to cover correspondent/intermediary charges. For this onboarding payment we are willing to absorb up to USD 50 of correspondent fees if the payment order references INV-2027-1173 and confirms sender-cover is not available. Any additional fees will be invoiced or deducted from future payments as agreed.

3) FX: If you send BRL to our Brazil account, your bank will perform the FX conversion unless you instruct otherwise. If you want Redwood to perform FX conversion on receipt to USD, send in USD to the U.S. account below. We do not guarantee mid-market FX; banks will apply their spreads. If you need a firm BRL amount to debit, ask your bank for a fee quote + BRL debit amount and share with us and we will confirm receipt amount.

Wire instruction snippets (paste to your bank):
- For USD (preferred if you can):
  Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
  Bank: First Federal Bank, New York
  Account (USD): 123456789
  Routing/SWIFT: FFBKUS33
  Reference: INV-2027-1173 / Globex Health
  Charges: OUR (customer pays all correspondent/intermediary fees)

- For BRL (local Brazil collection):
  Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Ltda.
  Bank: Banco do Brasil, São Paulo
  Account (BRL): 987654321
  Branch: 0001-2
  Reference: INV-2027-1173 / Globex Health
  Note: If your bank routes via an intermediate correspondent, request a fees breakdown and advise us ahead of payment.

VAT/tax: We will send a VAT invoice scan immediately after payment confirmation. If Globex requires the VAT/CF-e linked in advance for treasury approval, let us know and we’ll prioritise it.

Regards,
